name: mapeditor/tiled
description: Tiled is a flexible, general-purpose tile map and level editor for tile-based games (RPGs, platformers, etc.), supporting orthogonal, isometric, and hexagonal maps with a rich TMX format.
score_rationale: 12.4k stars, the industry-standard tile map editor with 15+ years of active development, March 2026 release, and near-universal adoption in 2D game development.
summary: Industry-standard tile map editor with orthogonal, isometric, hexagonal support
